messages:
maria: opened PR to add events.v2 table + migration + backfill. need a quick review before i schedule canary. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/3124
jon: will look in ~30m. any locks/downtime expected?
maria: should be online-friendly. adds an index CONCURRENTLY; backfill runs as a separate job, est ~2h for prod. snippet:
```sql
ALTER TABLE events ADD COLUMN v2 JSONB;
CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY idx_events_v2 ON events ((v2->>'type'));
```
sam: can you paste the CI link? last run failed data-quality test.
maria: re-ran CI, green now. CI: https://ci.redwood/3124
lee: can we canary in us-east-1 at 5% traffic and gate with a feature flag?
ira: backfill script batches 10k rows and sleeps between batches; safe to pause. left a tiny nit about transaction size in the PR.
jon: added comments about index name + rollback block. also request: add estimated peak CPU/mem for backfill to the PR description.
maria: added rollback block and peak CPU estimates to PR desc. created a short schedule spreadsheet for staging -> canary -> prod.
deploy-bot: staging deploy scheduled: 2026-02-15 03:00 UTC.
lee: if staging smoke looks good i can approve for canary after 1h of monitoring.
sam: :thumbsup: i'll run quick data validation after staging run and report anomalies.
maria: anyone else who needs to review? planning to merge after 12:00 UTC today if no objections.
jon: approve from me.
ira: approving after i see the nit addressed.
sam: approving.
maria: merged. starting canary backfill at 13:00 UTC, will post status here.
lee: noted — post perf & error rates here during canary.
maria: will do, will also post a short summary in #incidents if anything notable.
